contexts.text: Horns of ivory and ebony () = exterior goods, which are of worship, or of rituals.
With those who are deceitful, and have been hypocrites, the memory appears hardly bony, as of ivory, which reflects the rays of light.
By these things now mentioned, which are thyine wood, and every vessel of ivory () are meant natural goods and truths. Explained.

The reason ivory = natural truth, is that it is white, and can be polished; and because it is protended from the mouth of the elephant; and also constitutes its strength. As ivory = the natural truth of that good which is signified by thyine wood, it is said vessel of ivory; for by vessel is signified a containant; here, truth the containant of good.
Beds of ivory () = the fallacies of the senses upon which doctrine is founded.
Solomon made a great ivory throne... (). By of ivory is signified Divine truth in ultimates.
By ivories, apes, and peacocks () are signified the truths and goods of the External Church.
When a man is in mere intellectual thought about God, and the things which are of God, he appears to the Angels from afar like an image of ivory or marble...
Here... ivory (is an expression which = truth).
And every vessel of ivory, and every vessel of precious wood () = rational truths and goods profaned... Ivory = rational truth.

The reason ivory = rational truth, is that by the camel is signified what is Natural in general; hence by ivory, which is from its tooth, and from which it has its power, and also because it is white, and also resistant, is signified rational truth, which is the most excellent truth of the natural man. Illustrated.
Beds of ivory = doctrines as from rational truths.
The house of ivory and the great house () = the things of the natural man which are called rational; those as to truth are signified by the house of ivory...
As man as to the things of his mind is signified by a house, they formerly built houses of ivory, as we read of Ahab (), by which was signified man as to the Rational.
Palaces of ivory () = truths from the rational man, thus rational truths.
